# Quantum fixture

`mszip_lzx_qtm.cab` is the unmodified mixed-compression sample from the
libmspack corpus at commit `55d501976171397ccd5d5a7a1ca7da065b1d9a06`,
path `libmspack/test/test_files/cabd/mszip_lzx_qtm.cab`.

codec tests can run without a sibling checkout. Its Quantum member is `qtm.txt`.
